title: While loops
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: While-loops encode “repeat until a condition.” Always prove the condition eventually becomes false, or you own an infinite loop. Classic framing from the roadmap note “while loops in programming”.
intuition: Identify the progress measure — something must move toward termination each iteration.
pitfalls: Forgetting to update the condition variable.

python.code:
n = int(input())
i = 1
while i <= n:
    print(i, end=" ")
    i += 1
print()
